description: Ethanol, in whatever form it reaches you. Loosens you up, blurs the edges, then quietly takes your legs and the lights with them.

overdose.message: You've had far too much, far too fast. The room spins, you throw up, and then you pass out. Alcohol poisoning.

phases.comedown_message: Your mouth has gone dry and the lights seem too bright.
phases.comeup_message: It goes down warm. You don't feel anything yet.
phases.end_message: It wears off and leaves you tired. Sleep won't fix it.
phases.peak_message: It hits you all at once. You feel warm and friendly, and very sure of yourself.

withdrawal.message: Your hands shake, and you keep seeing things in the corners that aren't there.

stages.easing: Your hands steady first. For an hour you think it's over.
stages.onset: Your hands have a small shake, and you can't stop it.
stages.peak: Your whole body is shaking. Things move at the edge of your vision, and when you look, nothing's there.
stages.rising: You're sweating in a cold room and your heart is pounding, and you haven't done anything.
stages.tail: You can't sleep more than an hour or two at a time, and you wake up with a jolt every time. It'll be days before you sleep through the night again.

name: alcohol
